risks.risk: Brake condition (pads/lever function) and whether it stops safely
risks.proof: A short video of both brakes being squeezed while riding/rolling, showing the bike stopping.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing brake check/possible brake service.

risks.risk: Chain/sprocket wear and drivetrain smoothness (skipping, grinding)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of chain + sprocket teeth, and a video of pedaling showing smooth rotation without skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as drivetrain may need cleaning/lubrication or minor replacement.

risks.risk: Wheel alignment and tire condition (sidewall cracks, wobble, bent rim)
risks.proof: Photo of both wheels straight-on and a video rolling the bike to show any wobble; close-up of tire tread and sidewalls.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires/rims may need inspection or replacement.

risks.risk: Frame integrity and safety parts (handlebar tightness, seat post, pedals)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of handlebar stem, seat post clamp, and pedal threads; plus a video of pushing/pulling to show no looseness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possible loose/needs tightening parts.

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of brakes (front and rear), chain + sprocket, and both wheel rims/tires.
Send a short video: bike rolling + pedaling, and brakes tested (stop clearly).
Tell the wheel size (e.g., 12/14/16/18 inches) and approximate age/condition.
response.reason: The photo confirms it’s a kids bicycle, but key safety/condition factors (brakes, drivetrain, wheel alignment) aren’t verifiable from this single angle, so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set yet.
